name: InfiniSplat2
description: An interactive AI application on Hugging Face Spaces.

paragraphs: Upload overlapping images or a video to reconstruct a Gaussian scene. Reliable pose conditioning generally improves quality. The default first estimates cameras with DA3, then uses those cameras for pose-conditioned reconstruction. Provided GT / COLMAP cameras and pose-free inference are also supported.

Eight precomputed image examples include GT camera poses and the same GT-conditioned standalone SH0 viewers used for the project-page showcase. Source images retain their original spatial resolution and pixels. Selecting an example also loads its camera NPZ and matching reconstruction resolution; GT cameras can be downloaded. The two video examples have been removed. Video upload remains available.

Camera Pose is optional: upload an NPZ (OpenCV camera-to-world c2w [N,4,4] and original-pixel intrinsics [N,3,3], in image order) or undistorted COLMAP text cameras, or let DA3 estimate the cameras. New uploads default to 1036 px; example resolutions match their project-page results. Viewers use full resolution. Example PLY files are omitted; new reconstructions provide PLY and HTML downloads.
